The '''Wazta system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Wazta sector/Legends|Wazta sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wazta/Legends|Wazta]].
